description: This file defines various service functions for managing workouts, templates, exercises, and programs in a gym management system. It includes CRUD operations, ownership checks, pagination, and associations between entities.

methods.name: _paginate(query, page: int, page_size: int)
methods.description: Helper function to apply pagination to a SQLAlchemy query.

methods.name: wm.WorkoutTemplate ensure_trainer_owns_template(db: Session, trainer_id: int, template_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if a trainer owns a specific template, raises HTTP 404 if not.

methods.name: wm.Program ensure_trainer_owns_program(db: Session, trainer_id: int, program_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if a trainer owns a specific program, raises HTTP 404 if not.

methods.name: wm.Program ensure_member_can_view_program(db: Session, member_user_id: int, program_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if a member can view a program, raises HTTP 404 if not.

methods.name: ws.ExerciseOut create_exercise(db: Session, trainer_id: int, payload: ws.ExerciseCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new exercise associated with a trainer.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ws.ExerciseOut],int] list_exercises(db: Session, trainer_id: int, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists exercises created by a trainer with pagination.

methods.name: ws.WorkoutTemplateOut create_template(db: Session, trainer_id: int, payload: ws.WorkoutTemplateCreate)
methods.description: Creates a workout template and optionally associates exercises.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ws.WorkoutTemplateOut],int] list_templates(db: Session, trainer_id: int, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists workout templates for a trainer with pagination.

methods.name: ws.TemplateExerciseOut add_template_exercise(db: Session, trainer_id: int, template_id: int, payload: ws.TemplateExerciseCreate)
methods.description: Adds an exercise to a template after ownership verification.

methods.name: None delete_template_exercise(db: Session, trainer_id: int, template_id: int, template_exercise_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes a specific exercise from a template.

methods.name: ws.ProgramOut assign_program(db: Session, trainer_id: int, payload: ws.ProgramCreate)
methods.description: Creates and assigns a program to a member, optionally seeded from a template.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ws.ProgramOut],int] list_programs_for_trainer(db: Session, trainer_id: int, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists all programs created by a trainer.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ws.ProgramOut],int] list_programs_for_member(db: Session, member_user_id: int, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists all programs for a member.

methods.name: ws.ProgramDayOut create_program_day(db: Session, trainer_id: int, program_id: int, payload: ws.ProgramDayCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new day within a program.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ws.ProgramDayOut],int] list_program_days(db: Session, user_id: int, program_id: int, role: str, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 20)
methods.description: Lists days for a specific program, filtered by role.

methods.name: ws.ProgramDayExerciseOut add_program_day_exercise(db: Session, trainer_id: int, program_id: int, day_id: int, payload: ws.ProgramDayExerciseCreate)
methods.description: Adds an exercise to a specific program day.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ws.ProgramDayExerciseOut],int] list_program_day_exercises(db: Session, user_id: int, role: str, program_id: int, day_id: int, page: int = 1, page_size: int = 50)
methods.description: Lists exercises for a program day with role-based filtering.
